data.summary:
Process Excellence and Lean Six Sigma professional with 15+ years of experience across process consulting, business excellence, quality assurance, process discovery, continuous improvement and transformation. Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with hands-on experience building LSS capability, delivering Yellow Belt and Green Belt programmes, mentoring improvement projects, facilitating practitioner communities, and applying structured problem-solving methods including DMAIC, RCA, 5 Why, FMEA, Pareto analysis and Value Stream Mapping. Experienced in stakeholder facilitation, business process modelling, analytics, automation opportunities and cross-functional transformation across global corporate and client environments.
SELECTED CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
Trained 500+ practitioners across Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt and Green Belt programmes and mentored 50+ improvement
projects through certification.
Delivered quarterly Yellow Belt and biannual Green Belt programmes across 4 corporate accounts, training 30–35
practitioners per batch.
Established and facilitated Lean Six Sigma communities and forums engaging 200+ practitioners and senior leaders. • Led regional Process Excellence CoE activities and supported global stakeholder engagement across multiple client environments.
Delivered process improvement initiatives including a 50% reduction in document delivery time, 18% reduction in reporting
errors, and automation delivering 7 FTE cost savings.
Strong exposure to process discovery, process modelling, requirements elicitation, data analysis, quality systems, process
transition and automation.

certifications.name:

TOOLS
BusinessObjects, Salesforce, MS Access, Tally

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
CAPGEMINI | Jun 2024 – Present
Manager – Centre of Excellence
Lead a regional Centre of Excellence for Process Excellence, managing small-to-medium initiatives from initiation through
closure using Waterfall, Iterative and Agile approaches.
Deliver quarterly Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt and biannual Green Belt programmes across 4 corporate accounts; train 30–35
practitioners per batch and mentor improvement projects through certification.
Build and facilitate Lean Six Sigma communities and forums, engaging 200+ practitioners and senior leaders through
continuous improvement, retrospectives, data storytelling and advanced quality sessions.
Conduct Starfish Retrospection and Data Storytelling workshops for senior stakeholders to strengthen structured problem-
solving, engagement and continuous improvement culture.
• Deliver advanced quality training on Root Cause Analysis and FMEA and support adoption of structured problem-solving
practices.
Develop workplans, manage interdependencies and communicate project risks and delivery status to senior management. • Lead and drive industrialization projects for i-SPRINT, a Capgemini initiative, and participate in the NIQR Six Sigma Contest.
TATA COMMUNICATIONS LTD. | Oct 2018 – May 2024
Assistant Manager – Business Excellence
Led business excellence and process improvement initiatives for global client environments, including development of
quality frameworks and strategic process improvement plans.
Redesigned process flows using Lean practices and delivered Yellow Belt and Green Belt programmes across 2 client
accounts, mentoring practitioners through certification.
Consulted with stakeholders on improvement plans, project execution and assessment; established improvement
infrastructure and acted as a technical spokesperson for business project teams.
Developed benchmarks, analytics and performance metrics to support client decision-making and continuous
improvement.
Implemented continuous improvement and best-practice initiatives that reduced required document delivery time by 50%. • Led pre- and post-implementation assessment of improvement opportunities, increasing workflow efficiency and reducing overall cycle time.
Created SOPs, process maps and control documentation; monitored KPIs and supported quality-system improvements
using Poka-Yoke, on-the-job training and statistical analysis.
Facilitated stakeholder and customer requirement workshops, using structured questioning to elicit detailed business
needs and translate them into process and functional documentation.
Created use cases, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams and data dictionaries; owned end-to-end project documentation
and process transition.
Led and managed Business Analysts supporting business process development and process improvement initiatives. • Managed cross-functional teams, performed 5 Why and FMEA analysis, identified automation opportunities, and contributed to regional process-unification and transformation programmes. • Provided Lean Six Sigma training and mentoring across organisational levels.
MAERSK GLOBAL SERVICE CENTRE | May 2017 – Oct 2018
Senior Process Expert
Analysed business operations to identify inefficiencies, modelled processes and worked with stakeholders and clients to
document goals and improvement requirements.
Developed KPI and process-evolution reporting to support operational decision-making and performance management. • Performed advanced statistical analysis to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. • Created QlikView and SAP BusinessObjects reports to communicate complex data and improve management visibility; automated reporting and achieved an 18% reduction in reporting errors.
Documented business processes and operating procedures and supported process monitoring and improvement
initiatives.
WNS GLOBAL SERVICES LTD. | Jan 2006 – May 2017
Assistant Manager – Business Excellence
Developed and maintained quality plans, process policies and quality systems; managed process compliance and SLA
audits.
Applied 5 Why and Pareto analysis to identify root causes and improvement opportunities. • Created Work Instruction Manuals (WIMs), process maps and training modules. • Rolled out Lean Six Sigma capability-building programmes across 5 client accounts through practitioner training, project mentoring and continuous improvement practices.
Drove best-practice sharing and idea generation, compiled business-performance reports and coordinated audit data for
ISO requirements.
Managed team performance, targets and compliance with organisational policies and supported operational improvement
initiatives.
SIX SIGMA TECHNOLOGY PVT. LTD. | Aug 2005 – Dec 2005
Accounts Assistant
Managed petty cash and maintained accounts in Tally 6.3.
SQTL, VYOM LABS PVT. LTD. | May 2005 – Jul 2005
Counsellor / Administrator
Handled enquiry reports, daily cash collection, correspondence and telephonic/walk-in enquiries.
SELECTED TRANSFORMATION & AUTOMATION PROJECTS
Process unification across regions to streamline operations, enhance collaboration and standardise service delivery. • One-stop solution for Remedy and Nova tickets by consolidating ticketing systems and simplifying workflows. • RPA automation of manual and repetitive activities, generating cost savings equivalent to 7 FTEs. • Automation of the Maersk CRVR process covering cargo readiness and vessel reconciliation activities. • Integration of data sources and systems to automate fuel-consumption ETL into a Mainframe application, reducing labour effort.
Automation of SAP procurement reports and MS Access productivity, resource-utilisation and performance reporting. • Quality Check sample-size calculator to support statistically appropriate sampling and interpretation. • Automation of British Airways flight-cancellation activity in WINBABS.
